description: I own my world and nothing gets access without my permission #selfdiscovery #selflove #selfmastery
transcript: There isn't any thought that I have, or anything that exists in my internal world, that I haven't given permission to be there. There is nothing that has access to me that I have not allowed access. I am in full control of the way in which I react in the way in which I navigate situations, and I am in control of my internal world. There is nothing that can have access to me without knocking first.
